name: Send this to your person
title: “What keeps us strong?”
note: Send this to your person, Ecclesiastes 4:12, 3 slides, no redraws
caption:
For the one you would wait for. Send it to them.

Love holds up best when it is not carried by two people alone. With God woven through it, the hard seasons do not pull you apart.

Ecclesiastes 4:12 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
